spec.goal: Backfill Decodex GitHub signals for the full default comparison range from stable 0.116.0 to the latest tracked preview by running the content-generation loop locally once.
success_criteria: The repo has a deterministic backfill entrypoint that reads the selected stable-to-preview compare set and targets unpublished PRs in that range.
A local run covers the missing PR backlog for the current default compare pair, producing bundles, analysis drafts, rendered signals, and a refreshed release-delta artifact.
Repo-native verification passes after the backfill run and the resulting coverage can be summarized concretely.
constraints: Use the active GitHub-first lane and existing signal/release-delta contracts unless a compatible extension is strictly required.
Run the backfill locally with the user's Codex auth rather than depending on GitHub Actions for this one-off catch-up.
Preserve existing published signals and regenerate only missing content in the selected compare range.

tasks.title: Define the compare-driven backfill contract
tasks.objective: Ground the backfill work in current release-delta evidence and record the need for a compare-driven unpublished-PR runner.
outputs: A validated plan/1 contract for the 0.116 backfill pass
A clear implementation direction for compare-based backlog replay

tasks.title: Implement the local backfill runner
tasks.objective: Add a deterministic script that reads the chosen compare pair, finds unpublished PRs in that compare set, and runs the existing bundle-analysis-render pipeline for them.
outputs: A local backfill command for 0.116-to-latest unpublished PRs

tasks.title: Run the local 0.116 backfill pass
tasks.objective: Execute the new backfill runner locally against the default 0.116.0 -> latest preview compare until the unpublished backlog for that pair is generated.
outputs: New bundles, analysis drafts, and signal entries for the missing PR backlog

tasks.title: Rebuild artifacts and run repo-native verification
tasks.objective: Refresh the release-delta artifact against the expanded signal set and run the repo-native validation gate.
outputs: An updated release-delta artifact and passing verification evidence

tasks.title: Summarize the backfill coverage
tasks.objective: Measure how much of the 0.116.0 -> latest preview compare is now represented in published signals and record any remaining gap.
outputs: Concrete coverage counts and any residual missing PR list

triggers: The compare-driven backfill runner cannot finish because the default compare contains too many PRs for one local pass
Codex analysis needs a skip/non-publish mode to avoid flooding the feed with clearly low-value PRs
The default release-delta pair changes while the backfill is running

evidence: CODEX_HOME=<temp> python3 tools/github/backfill_release_range.py --repo openai/codex --stable-tag rust-v0.116.0 --model gpt-5.3-codex-spark
